episodes.187602: Remnants of a cold front and light steering winds generated slow-moving showers around Toa Baja and its vicinity, which led to flooding in Levitown late in the night. Also, a funnel cloud developed earlier in the day in Culebra.
episodes.188096: Well above normal rainfall along the Ohio River Valley in January led to rising rivers, with flood stage exceeded slightly at Shawneetown by the end of the month, continuing into early February. Minor flooding resulted in very limited impacts in bottomland areas.
episodes.188097: Well above normal rainfall along the Ohio River Valley in January led to rising rivers, with flood stage exceeded slightly at Newburgh Lock and Dam and Mount Vernon by the end of the month, continuing into early February. Minor flooding resulted in very limited impacts in bottomland areas.
episodes.188173: Well above normal rainfall along the Ohio River Valley in January led to rising rivers, with flood stage exceeded slightly across the river from Newburgh Lock and Dam, Mount Vernon, and Shawneetown by the end of the month, continuing into early February. Minor flooding resulted in very limited impacts in bottomland areas.

events.narrative: The public reported through social media (Facebook) a funnel cloud just east of Zoni Beach in Culebra.
